title: A computer cannot host a unified consciousness

statements.text: A computer cannot host a unified consciousness, however complex, because it is not a live coherent symbol controlled from within by a self. As far as is known, only living organisms have the organization to represent such a symbol, which marks the difference between an organism and a classical or quantum computer.

sources.quote: The computer cannot host a unified consciousness because it is not a live coherent symbol, no matter how complex it is.
This is the fundamental difference between a living organism and a classical or quantum computer.
